level.title: Elementary: 了/过, ability, places, food
goals: Talk about past with 了 and 过
Express ability with 会/能/可以
Move around, eat out and shop

lessons.title: 了 and 过
lessons.learn: Past helpers! Verb + 了 (completed): 我吃了 (I ate). Didn't: 没吃 (NOT 不吃 for past!). Experience: 过 (have done): 我吃过 (I've eaten before). 已经 = already!

grammar.title: Verb了 · 没verb · Verb过
grammar.explain: 我吃了 (I ate), 我没吃 (I didn't eat), 我吃过 (I've eaten before). 没 = past-negative! 过 = ever-experience!

examples.r: zuó tiān wǒ dú le shū.
wǒ chī guo Běi jīng kǎo yā!

mistakes: Saying 不吃 for past — past-negative: 没吃!
Saying 吃了过 — pick ONE: 了 or 过!

dialogue.r: zuó tiān nǐ zuò shén me le?
wǒ xué xí le. rán hòu wán le!

lessons.title: 会/能/可以 + 想/要
lessons.learn: Three CANS! 会 (learned skill: 我会说中文), 能 (able: 我能去), 可以 (may/allowed: 可以进来吗?). Wants: 想 (would like), 要 (want/will). 想喝茶 (I'd like tea), 我要走了 (I'm leaving)!

grammar.title: 会/能/可以 + 想/要
grammar.explain: 我会游泳 (I can swim — learned), 我能来 (I can come — able), 可以坐吗? (may I sit?). 想吃 (would like to eat), 我要茶 (I want tea / I'll have tea)!
mistakes: Saying 我能说中文 for skills — skills: 会!
Saying 我要想 — pick ONE: 想 or 要!

dialogue.r: nǐ huì shuō Zhōng wén ma?

lessons.title: 在/去/从…到
lessons.learn: Move! 在 (at), 去 (go to), 从…到 (from…to): 从家到学校 (from home to school). 这里/那里/哪里 = here/there/where! 你去哪里? = Where are you going?

grammar.title: 在 · 去 · 从…到
grammar.explain: 我在家 (I'm at home), 我去学校 (I go to school), 从北京到上海 (from Beijing to Shanghai). Verbs of going demand 去!
mistakes: Saying 我在去学校 — going: 我去学校!
Saying 我去在家 — at-home: 我在家!

lessons.title: 去/来/回 + 点
lessons.learn: Move! 去 (go), 来 (come), 回 (return). Time + 点: 六点 (6 o'clock), 六点半 (6:30). 明天我去北京 = Tomorrow I go to Beijing. Leaving: 我走了! Back: 我回来了!!

grammar.title: Movement + 点 time
grammar.explain: 六点去 (go at 6), 明天来 (come tomorrow). Leaving home: 我走了! Return: 我回来了! Family: 回来了!

examples.r: míng tiān wǒ qù Běi jīng.

mistakes: Saying 六去 without 点 — clock-times need 点!
Saying 再见 when leaving home — say 我走了!

lessons.title: 喜欢 / 爱
lessons.learn: Likes! 喜欢鱼 (I like fish), 爱喝茶 (I love tea-drinking). 喜欢 + noun OR verb! 最喜欢 = favorite: 我最喜欢饺子! Order: 我要这个!

grammar.title: 喜欢 + noun/verb · 最喜欢
grammar.explain: 喜欢鱼 (like fish), 喜欢喝茶 (like drinking tea), 最喜欢饺子 (favorite is dumplings)! 爱 = deep love: 爱你!

examples.r: wǒ zuì xǐ huan jiǎo zi!

mistakes: Saying 很喜欢喜欢 — one 喜欢 only!

lessons.title: Shopping: 多少钱
lessons.learn: Shop in Chinese! 多少钱? (How much?), 贵 (expensive), 便宜 (cheap). Money: 块/元 (yuan). 这个/那个 = this one/that one. 我要这个 = I'll take this! 太贵了! = Too expensive!

grammar.title: 多少钱? + 这个/那个
grammar.explain: 这个多少钱? (How much is this one?), 一百块 (100 yuan). 我要这个! = I'll take this one! 太…了 = too: 太贵了!
grammar.pattern: 这个 + 多少钱? · 太 + adj + 了
mistakes: Saying 多少 without 钱 — prices: 多少钱!
Saying 这多少钱 — ones: 这个多少钱!

dialogue.t: 太贵了! 奶酪多少钱?
dialogue.r: tài guì le! nǎi lào duō shao qián?
dialogue.en: Too expensive! How much is the cheese?

dialogue.r: hěn pián yi! wǒ yào zhè ge!
